title: passwordEncoder_encodesAndMatches
asserts: The configured PasswordEncoder round-trips a password.

title: adminUser_canAccessOwners
asserts: GET /api/owners with admin Basic auth is 200.
notes: Flagged 'modified' by the manifest but byte-identical to origin/main; only shifted lines.

title: ownerAdmin_canListVets
asserts: An OWNER_ADMIN (not just a vet admin) can GET /api/vets.
notes: #37: the precondition for the visit forms' vet picker having anything to show in a real deployment (s3). Asserts only the endpoint's status, not that any picker uses it.

title: ownerAdmin_cannotAddAVet
asserts: An OWNER_ADMIN's POST /api/vets does not go through (not 200/201).
notes: Access-control boundary drawn alongside #37's read-side change (owner-admins now read vets); asserts nothing about visits or the vet link itself, so it is not linked to any sentence.
